auth.description: basic (default): your username and HTTP password (Settings > HTTP Credentials). none: anonymous, for public servers; "self" queries need a login.

sections.description: One list each, from a Gerrit search query. Default: Mine (is:open owner:self) and To review (is:open reviewer:self -owner:self -is:wip).

token_command.description: A command that prints the HTTP password, e.g. [op, read, "op://dev/gerrit/password"]. Used instead of token_env.

token_env.description: Variable holding the HTTP password. Default GERRIT_HTTP_PASSWORD.

username.description: Your Gerrit username, for auth: basic.

A -2 or failed Verified shows red, a -1 yellow, a +2 green. Click a change to open it. Untested live with a login: built from the API docs and a sample response. Anonymous queries (auth none) were checked on a public server.
